information_flow: The first call receives all six common inputs and emits one non-policy quotient containing observable obligations without granting implementation provenance authority. The final call consumes that quotient plus all six common inputs, retains full evidence visibility, and emits one policy through a single nonbranching lineage.
name: Provenance-Quotient Obligation Lift

calls.objective: Extract observable obligations, validity duties, and behavioral tensions from the supplied evidence; neutralize implementation provenance as authority; emit one non-policy obligation quotient without proposing edits, causal repairs, alternatives, or policy logic.

Consume the immediately preceding quotient as construction authority and the common inputs as visible contract evidence, then emit exactly one complete contract-compliant policy whose lineage is obligation-derived rather than anchor-edit-derived.
